summary: Cleanup routine on a __thiscall object: frees up to three optional pointer sub-allocations at this+0x150, this+0x154 and this+0x158 via FreeWrapper_7bcf (each guarded on non-null), then calls ObjectReleaseArrayIterator on this and returns its result. The function behaves like a destructor for an object that owns several heap sub-objects plus an array.

operations.description: Guard: if the dword at this+0x150 is non-zero, the first pointer is considered allocated and is freed.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf with the pointer loaded from this+0x150 to free the first sub-allocation.
Guard: if the dword at this+0x154 is non-zero, the second pointer is considered allocated and is freed.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf with the pointer loaded from this+0x154 to free the second sub-allocation.
Guard: if the dword at this+0x158 is non-zero, the third pointer is considered allocated and is freed.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf with the pointer loaded from this+0x158 to free the third sub-allocation.
Call ObjectReleaseArrayIterator(this) to release the array owned by the object and obtain a status result. The call target address is absent from the packet evidence.
Return the result produced by ObjectReleaseArrayIterator(this).

unresolved: Call target address and signature of ObjectReleaseArrayIterator are not present in the packet callee evidence; only its name appears in the raw source.
Identity of the object type owning the three freed pointers and the released array; no class or owner evidence exists.

Whether the three pointers at this+0x150/0x154/0x158 are the same allocation type or distinct object types is unresolved.
